map.❌ 猫狗绝对禁用药物：: ❌ Absolutely forbidden drugs for cats and dogs:
map.• 猫极敏感，少量即可致死（1片即可致死）: • Cats are extremely sensitive; a small amount can be fatal (even one tablet can kill)
map.• 狗过量也会导致肝损伤和溶血: • Overdose in dogs also causes liver damage and hemolysis
map.• 猫狗都禁用，可致胃肠溃疡、肾衰竭: • Forbidden for both cats and dogs; can cause gastric ulcer and kidney failure
map.• 除非兽医处方，否则不要用: • Do not use unless prescribed by a veterinarian
map.• 柯利犬、喜乐蒂、边牧等MDR1基因缺陷品种禁用: • Forbidden for MDR1-gene-defect breeds such as Collie, Shetland Sheepdog and Border Collie
map.1. 不确定时先问兽医，不要百度自行用药: 1. When unsure, ask a vet first; do not search online and medicate by yourself
map.2. 幼宠/孕宠/老年宠用药需特别谨慎: 2. Use extra caution for puppies/kittens, pregnant and senior pets
map.3. 肝肾功能不全者剂量需调整: 3. Dose must be adjusted for impaired liver/kidney function
map.4. 严格按疗程用药，不要自行停药: 4. Follow the course strictly; do not stop medication on your own
map.5. 用药后观察反应，异常立即就医: 5. Observe reactions after medication; seek care immediately if abnormal
map.6. 记录用药时间和剂量，避免重复用药: 6. Record medication time and dose to avoid duplicate dosing
map.• 药片：可包裹在零食/奶酪/营养膏中: • Tablets: wrap in a treat / cheese / nutritional paste
map.• 液体：用注射器从嘴角慢慢推入: • Liquids: use a syringe to slowly push from the corner of the mouth
map.• 胶囊：直接塞进喉咙深处，按摩颈部帮助吞咽: • Capsules: place deep in the throat and massage the neck to help swallow
map.• 喂药后给少量水，避免药物黏附食道: • Give a little water after dosing to avoid the drug sticking to the esophagus
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不能替代兽医诊断。宠物生病请及时就医，不要自行用药。: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only and cannot replace a veterinarian's diagnosis. If your pet is sick, seek timely care and do not medicate by yourself.
map.📚 深度解析：宠物常用药剂量计算器: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Pet Common Medication Dosage Calculator
map.按宠物体重与所选药品的安全剂量范围（mg/kg），算出单次与每日给药剂量，避免过: From the pet's body weight and the selected drug's safe dosage range (mg/kg), compute the single and daily doses to avoid overdose.
map.根据给药频次（单次 / 每 8、12、24 小时）折算每日总剂量，匹配药品说明书: Convert to daily total dose by dosing frequency (single / every 8, 12, 24 hours) and match the drug label.
map.把毫克剂量换算成 50/100/250mg 片剂片数，方便居家分药（仅供参考，遵: Convert the mg dose into the number of 50/100/250 mg tablets for easy home dosing (reference only; follow the vet's prescription).
map.示例：10kg 犬的某药剂量: Example: dose of a drug for a 10 kg dog
map.设药品对犬剂量范围 5–10 mg/kg：单次剂量 = 10kg × (5~10: Suppose the drug's canine dose range is 5–10 mg/kg: single dose = 10 kg × (5–10) = 50–100 mg, average 75 mg; if every 12 hours (24÷12 = 2 times/day), daily total 100–200 mg; a 50 mg tablet is about 75÷50 = 1.50 tablets. The exact range follows the drug data sheet.
map.单次剂量 = 体重(kg) × 药品剂量范围(mg/kg)；平均剂量取上下限均值: Single dose = body weight (kg) × drug dose range (mg/kg); average dose is the mean of the limits; daily total = average dose × doses per day (single = 1, every N hours = 24÷N). When some drugs are labeled 'not recommended' for a species, a contraindication is shown.
map.算出来就能直接喂吗？: Can you just feed it once calculated?
map.不能。本工具仅为剂量参考，实际用药必须凭兽医处方；肝肾病、孕宠、幼老宠的剂量常需: No. This tool is only a dosage reference; actual medication must be by veterinary prescription; doses for liver/kidney disease, pregnant, young and senior pets often need reduction, and most human drugs are toxic to pets, so never apply them directly.
